name: Sheraton Hong Kong Hotel & Towers
positioning: A Tsim Sha Tsui hotel on Nathan Road along Victoria Harbour, with a harbour-facing rooftop pool, rooms with harbour and skyline views and a Sheraton Club lounge
best_for: Travelers who want a room with views of Victoria Harbour and the Hong Kong skyline
Guests who want an outdoor rooftop pool facing the harbour
Families who want a character-themed Family Room with harbour views

facts.text: The hotel is set on Nathan Road along Victoria Harbour.
There is subway access right outside the hotel's doors.
The hotel is within easy reach of the Hong Kong Museum of Art and the Cultural Centre.
A jogging course runs next to the hotel along the waterfront overlooking Victoria Harbour.
The rooftop pool has a sundeck for sunbathing.
Rooms and suites feature designer furnishings and floor-to-ceiling windows.
Rooms offer the Sheraton Sleep Experience.
Oyster & Wine Bar serves freshly shucked oysters, premium wines and fine spirits against the backdrop of Victoria Harbour.
Qibla direction is provided in all guest rooms, and a Quran and prayer mat are available on request.
The concierge team is available 24 hours a day.

highlights.text: The outdoor, temperature-controlled rooftop pool is on Level 18, faces the harbour and has three heated Jacuzzis.
Many rooms and suites feature sweeping views of Victoria Harbour and the Hong Kong skyline.
The hotel is located along Victoria Harbour in the heart of Tsim Sha Tsui's business, shopping, cultural and entertainment district.
The Sheraton Club is a private lounge area with a harbour view, for guests who value privacy and personal service.
The hotel offers a character-themed Family Room with Victoria Harbour views.

considerations.text: Rooms do not have a coffee or tea maker.
Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the surrounding Tsim Sha Tsui area is one of Hong Kong's busiest districts and may not suit travelers seeking a quiet retreat.
